info.title: TestCaller - persistent text commands for real audio calls
info.description: Interactive Windows x64 and macOS arm64 voice-call CLI with Twilio, SIP, WebSocket calls, speech synthesis, transcription, microphone input, and recording. Speech models download separately.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Shell: TestCaller.exe [options]
Source: dotnet run --no-build -- [options]  (first run dotnet build)

options.name: --play-audio
options.description:
Play both caller and target through the default speakers.
Off by default; target transcription remains active.

options.name: --microphone
options.description:
Send this microphone directly to the call, bypassing local STT.
Use a name from --list-microphones, quoted if it contains spaces.
Starts on connection, stops on hangup; off when omitted.

options.name: --no-record
options.description: Disable the default local call recording.

options.name: --sip-auth
options.description:
Optional username:password or ip:<local-address>.
Omit for SIP without digest auth; also set via TESTCALLER_SIPAUTH.

options.name: --voice
options.description: Default af_heart (the only voice shipped in the ZIP).

options.name: --logs
options.description:
Optional demo server diagnostics; default none.
Files append JSONL. Logs do not supply the Agent: transcript.

options.name: --logs-url
options.description: Override the same-origin /logs endpoint for demo calls.
